subject: Post-call: PayTile compliance checklist & evidence next steps
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@paytile.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: PayTile compliance checklist & evidence next steps

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the demo and the honest discussion today. Wanted to capture the items we agreed and the next steps so your security team has a single reference. High level summary first, then specific asks.

Quick recap of pain/goals you shared:
- Auditability: need fine-grained audit logs (user, API keys, model, timestamp) retained for 2 years for core payments flows.
- Data residency & DPA alignment: PayTile needs contractual DPA language and confirmation that inference logs can be scoped/excluded for regulated PII.
- SOC 2 evidence: you want a short SOC 2 summary plus a list of artifacts we can share (scoped).
- Pen test / security testing: your vendor will need pen test results or a statement of recent assessments and remediation windows.

Immediate next steps we committed to:
1) I will share a compact SOC 2 summary and our audit-log retention policy. (attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-audit-log-retention-policy.pdf)
2) Marissa will follow up with the evidence checklist (attachment: requested-evidence-checklist.xlsx) so you can tell us which artifacts you require and any format preferences.
3) Karthik to coordinate a short security-to-security sync if PayTile needs deeper dive on KV caching / retention scoping.
4) If PayTile requires any DPA redline, we can provide our standard clause + engage legal on expedited review.

Please confirm if the list above matches your expectations and add anything I missed. If the security team prefers, we can route the checklist to security@paytile.com and lock a 30-min slot for Wednesday morning PST.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB), redwood-audit-log-retention-policy.pdf (PDF, 340KB)

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@paytile.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: PayTile Security <security@paytile.com>, Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@paytile.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: PayTile compliance checklist & evidence next steps

Vivek — this is great, thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Retention: we need logs for 24 months for payment-event related requests; for non-payment telemetry 90 days is fine. Can Redwood support per-route retention windows?
- DPA: we'd prefer Redwood to provide a copy of the standard DPA with the redlineable clauses called out.
- SOC 2: a redwood SOC 2 summary + a list of specific artifacts (e.g. sysadmin access logs, patching cadence, encryption key management) will help our InfoSec triage.

Attaching our security intake doc so you can map your artifacts to our ask. If possible, can you provide an expected ETA for the checklist responses? We are trying to complete vendor approval by Sep 10.

Attachment: paytile-security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 250KB)

Best,
Sophie Lane
Head of Product Security | PayTile Inc
sophie.lane@paytile.com

Hi Sophie — thanks for the questionnaire, that's very helpful. I've attached a paired checklist that maps the common PayTile asks to where we typically fulfill them. For each row you'll see: artifact name, typical redaction notes, approximate delivery speed (same-day, 3 business days, 10 business days). Please let us know if you need native log exports vs. PDF extracts — that affects ETA.

High-level items we'll include in the checklist delivery:
- SOC 2 Type II summary + scope statement (PDF)
- A readout of audit-log fields we capture (API key id, model id, request id, timestamp, src IP) and where we can drop/keep fields per-route
- Retention policy with per-route exceptions and deletion workflows
- Pen test summary/statement of most recent engagement and remediation timeline

We expect to populate the checklist and share the first tranche of artifacts by Thu, Aug 26 (EOD PDT) if PayTile confirms the preferred output format (PDF vs. CSV/native).

Attachments: requested-evidence-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 35KB)

Thanks — Marissa
